description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Plastic Nut for the Front Side Marker Lights
These Clip into the Sheet Metal and act as a nut for the Attachment Screw.
Requires 2 Per Side.
Genuine Suzuki OEM Part
Includes Both Sides!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Plastic Nuts, Front Side Marker Lights (LH & RH)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
SJ410 1982 – 1984 All Models
